company.name: DeepSeek
company.tagline: Pioneering highly cost-efficient frontier intelligence and open-weight mixture-of-experts architectures.
company.overview: DeepSeek is a Shanghai-based AI research lab focused on scaling frontier intelligence with extreme efficiency. Known for introducing high-performance open-weight models, DeepSeek advances machine learning through proprietary Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing, specialized coding engines, and top-tier mathematical reasoning pipelines.

llms.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro / High
llms.short_tagline: Frontier text model optimized for advanced reasoning and coding.
llms.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro represents their flagship open-weight general text model. Engineered to compete with proprietary Western models on coding, logical inference, and multilingual tasks, it delivers state-of-the-art parameters for self-hosted enterprise workloads.

llms.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash (Max)
llms.short_tagline: High-speed MoE model supporting a 1M token context window.
llms.description: DeepSeek V4 Flash is a latency-optimized Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model built for real-time conversational agents. Featuring an expansive 1-million token context window, it enables extremely fast retrieval and reasoning over massive document bundles at a fraction of standard API costs.

llms.name: DeepSeek R1 Reasoning
llms.short_tagline: Open reasoning model generating detailed logical thinking chains.
llms.description: DeepSeek R1 is a specialized reasoning model designed to solve complex mathematics, logical reasoning, and programming challenges. By generating explicit, structured step-by-step thinking processes before outputting answers, it provides highly reliable logic checks for agent planners.

llms.name: DeepSeek V3 / V3.2
llms.short_tagline: Proven open-weights model with excellent developer benchmarks.
llms.description: DeepSeek V3 represents a stable, highly capable open-weights model family. Widely adopted for coding assists and prompt completion tasks, it offers balanced parameters that run efficiently on standard enterprise GPU nodes.

platforms.name: DeepSeek Developer Platform
platforms.description: The DeepSeek Developer Platform provides high-availability API endpoints for integrating DeepSeek models into developer applications. Featuring OpenAI API compatibility, it allows developers to swap endpoints with one line of code, benefiting from industry-lowest token pricing.

platforms.name: DeepSeek Chat Hub
platforms.short_tagline: Direct conversational interface for model testing.
platforms.description: DeepSeek Chat is the web-accessible chat interface for interacting with DeepSeek models directly. Developers use it to run quick prompt engineering experiments, benchmark responses against API tasks, and test multimodal capabilities.

learning.name: DeepSeek API Quickstart Guides
learning.short_tagline: Code recipes for python, node, and curl integrations.
learning.description: Official guides explaining API authentication, model parameters, streaming setups, and error handling. Developers use these recipes to configure robust API integrations in minutes.

learning.name: DeepSeek Newsroom & Research
learning.short_tagline: Official research papers and architecture updates.
learning.description: The official DeepSeek newsroom containing research announcements, architectural disclosures (like DeepSeekMoE), and detailed model evaluation benchmarks.

technologies.name: DeepSeekMoE Architecture
technologies.description: DeepSeek's proprietary Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework designed to reduce compute costs. By routing tokens to specialized shared and fine-grained experts, it achieves frontier performance with a fraction of active parameters.

docsAndNews.name: Developer Docs Portal
docsAndNews.description: The primary developer hub for accessing API guides, billing setups, and model capabilities.

docsAndNews.name: Official AI Website
docsAndNews.description: The global portal for DeepSeek, providing downloads, chat web apps, and researcher contact.

docsAndNews.name: Model Hub / Open-Weight Releases
docsAndNews.short_tagline: Git repositories and open weights models.
docsAndNews.description: Access official model weight codes, research configurations, and model pipelines on GitHub.

docsAndNews.name: Product & Research Blog
docsAndNews.description: Technical announcements and engineering updates on model releases and training insights.
